title: Deeper Climb
notes: Talent tree v2: each branch now has 4 talents with 10 ranks plus 2 ★ keystones that change how you fight (Berserker, Executioner, Second Life, Thorns, Treasure Sense, Crystal Heart). Far more ranks than points: pick your style.
More talent points over time: 1 per level, +1 per 10 Training Tower floors, +2 per rank exam.
Training Tower map: see the next 5 floors with place, rewards, elites, bosses and modifiers.
Floor modifiers keep the climb fresh: Golden (x2 Gold), Giants, Swarm, Frenzy and Spirit Surge, each with bigger rewards.
Tabs now always open at the top. Bosses break a bit faster.
